Pramod Pappan | Pramod Pappan are an Indian screenwriter and film director duo .  They started film direction with "Vajram (2004)", in which Mammootty played the lead role.  They directed films such as "Thaskaraveeran" (2005), "Abraham & Lincoln" (2007), "Mussafir" (2013), "Black Stallion" (2009) and "Bangkok Summer" (2011).
